title: My AI doesn't pick trades. It stops me from being an idiot. (open source, free)
author: mphinance
selftext:
Mostly created to fix my position sizing in futures, but I also wanted to see the 15m, 1h, and tick charts all sitting next to my 5m at all times. 

https://github.com/tradernetwork/projectx-desk

https://mphinance.substack.com/p/phd-in-self-sabotage-my-ai-trading?utm\_source=share&utm\_medium=android&r=1sctub

\- Three losses in a row = locked out

\- Sizes from remaining loss room + ATR stop, always rounds down. If 1 contract risks too much, it says REFUSED and tells you why

\- Stop goes out right after the fill. No ack in 5 sec = flatten and halt

\- Stops only move toward price. No widening because "hope"

\- AI can STAGE a trade. Only I can PLACE it (hold 600 ms)

\- Shows my win rate next to the win rate I need to break even. Flags SMALL SAMPLE under 30 trades

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: an AI that only ever says no is the version I'd actually trust. a sizing cap it enforces before the order goes out is worth more than any signal it could pick for you.

comments.author: QATSAlgo
comments.body:
The REFUSED state is worth preserving in the audit log, with the loss-room snapshot and the contract rounding that caused it. I’d also test the awkward case where the stop acknowledgement is late while flatten is already in flight: reconcile the actual position before permitting another entry, and make those commands idempotent.



We’re QATS. If you ever want to try a separate perpetuals-prop adapter, our Trading API has account/risk state, order/position operations and persisted idempotency keys: [https://quantityproject.github.io/qats-trader-api/](https://quantityproject.github.io/qats-trader-api/) . It is not a ProjectX drop-in connection or CME futures feed. QATS evaluations and initial funded accounts are simulated, with plan limits enforced server-side.
